exposure: Ultrasound-estimated fetal weight (US-EFW) within 35 days of delivery
Nulliparous women with medication-requiring gestational or pregestational diabetes
Women without US-EFW within 35 days of delivery
Women with US-EFW within 35 days of delivery
cohort: Nulliparous women with medication-requiring gestational or pregestational diabetes who delivered term, singleton gestations following a trial of labor (n=304)
finding: An ultrasound-estimated fetal weight within 35 days of delivery among nulliparous women with medication-requiring diabetes was positively associated with intrapartum cesarean delivery.
